runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Existing LIVE items are never removed merely because a discovery run does not rediscover them.
runSummary.note: Real 14.9.2026 22:40 sweep across 12 source families. Strongest new exact-fit opportunity is an Upwork entry-level $50 fixed plugin test requiring a live public WooCommerce shop; KomArena directly satisfies that unusual prerequisite, but the listing already shows 1 hire, 1 interview and 20-50 proposals, so it is promotion-ready rather than guaranteed. IKEA customer services canonical job 354106 was reverified active. Kariera exposed Dotypos contact-centre Bratislava from 1,500 EUR/month, but only category-level evidence was obtained, so it remains verification-needed rather than LIVE. LinkedIn Wolt support roles were active but require minimum B2 English. Facebook produced 0 verified direct-post hits. No LIVE deletion was performed.

developmentChanges.title: Prerequisite asset-match score
developmentChanges.reason: Score unusual job prerequisites against assets already owned or operated by the candidate, such as a live WooCommerce store, WordPress admin access, Home Assistant lab or vehicle. This surfaces low-friction opportunities that generic keyword ranking misses.

developmentChanges.title: Category-index detail escalation SLA
developmentChanges.reason: When a job board exposes only title/location/pay at category level, persist a verification-needed record with a short recheck SLA and never promote until full detail confirms language, activity and employment conditions. This prevents attractive snippets from becoming false LIVE positives.
